_comment: Causes specific to THIS repo, unioned with the shared table in scripts/ci-known-causes.json. Same field shape. Put a row here when the cause is about this project; put it in ai-standards (and re-vendor) when any repo could hit it. Every row needs a `prevent` mechanism as well as a `fix` — the corpus asserts it, because prevention is the half that gets skipped once the build is green again.

causes.cause: n8n's Read/Write Files node cannot write at any path in the hardened image — not a permissions or mount problem.
causes.fix: Do not have n8n persist anything. Put the state in a service we control (router, lanes) or in workflow static data. See the ADR 0006 addendum.
causes.prevent: State lives in a service we control (router, lanes) or in workflow static data. n8n is never given a persistence job, so the limitation cannot be rediscovered.

causes.cause: An auth token in docker-compose.yml uses ${VAR:-} (defaults to empty) instead of ${VAR:?} (refuses to start).
causes.fix: Change that variable to ${VAR:?set it in .env}. An empty token does not fail loudly — it makes every call 401.
causes._note: Matched a PASS line before same_line existed: the security test prints the rule name whether it passes or fails.
causes.prevent: scripts/security_test.py asserts every auth token in compose uses the required ${VAR:?} form. An empty token that 401s every call is caught before it starts, not after.

causes.cause: A workflow has no meta.description, so it would render as a blank row in the use-case register.
causes.fix: Add meta.description to each file named in the error. The register is the inventory; a blank row is worse than a missing one.
causes.prevent: scripts/workflow_lint.py fails CI on a workflow with no meta.description, so the register cannot acquire a blank row in the first place.

causes.cause: A workflow activated via `n8n update:workflow --active=true` shows active=1 in the database but its Schedule Trigger is not registered with the running process, so it never fires.
causes.fix: Restart the n8n container after activating from the CLI. Same class as the webhook-registration lesson already recorded in ADR 0006.
causes.prevent: n8n_bootstrap.py --activate should restart n8n, or print the restart as a required next step, rather than reporting success on a workflow that will not fire.
causes._note: Found by checking the EXECUTION count rather than trusting the active flag. 'Activated' and 'running' are different facts, and the flag only proves the first.

causes.cause: A new endpoint was added to lanes/server.py but the running container still has the old code. server.py is BAKED INTO THE IMAGE at /srv/server.py; only ./scripts is bind-mounted, so editing the host file changes nothing until a rebuild.
causes.fix: docker compose up -d --build lanes. Then verify the route exists in the container rather than on the host.
causes.prevent: The scripts/ bind mount is what makes this surprising — script edits take effect immediately, so server.py silently behaves differently from everything beside it. Any change to server.py needs a rebuild in the same action.
causes._note: Cost two errored unattended runs. The lane was correct, the workflow was correct, the endpoint was correct on disk, and the 404 came from code that had been running for seven hours.

match: is a string but was expecting a number
causes.cause: An n8n IF node uses a TYPED operator (e.g. type 'number', operation 'exists') against a field that is null. Strict type validation rejects it before the operation runs, so the node errors on a value the payload uses deliberately.
causes.fix: Use a boolean EXPRESSION as leftValue — `={{ $json.x !== null && $json.x !== undefined }}` with operator {type: boolean, operation: true, singleValue: true}. That sidesteps type coercion entirely.
causes.prevent: Design payloads so 'nothing happened' is a value the gate can read without coercion, and prefer boolean expressions over typed operators in IF nodes whose input can be null. A null that means 'normal' must not be able to fail the branch that tests for it.
causes._note: The dispatch lane errored on its OWN HEALTHY STATE: `dispatched: null` is the designed empty-queue result, and the gate meant to detect it is what failed.
